data.description:
## Context
Child of epic 5c34-4343-a3e6-4ad5; follows task 5c45-3070-800c-4914 (evidence bases). Phase 2: failure-mode taxonomy and WA gap matrix in `docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`.

## Plan
Distill 12–15 evidence-cited failure modes (IDs F1..Fn) from the failure corpus — e.g. big-bang collapse, write-back underestimation, incumbent lock-in via M&O scope drift (GA contract 2014035 amendments), funding cliff mid-wave (WA contraction; NY IES termination), workforce absorption overload, data-migration debt, governance/coalition decay (WAHBE seam), expired-vendor cliff (NY WMS), half-finished strangler (AZ HEAplus/AZTECS), savings-realization lag, error-rate/federal-liability exposure, decision-rights vacuum. Each row cites >=1 corpus instance. Then cross WA against each: status evidenced / assumed-in-memo / unknown, citing the specific WA record (corpus doc, memo labeled assumption, or coverage-report gap). Questions in phase 3 may come only from assumed/unknown cells with highest severity. Matrix lands as Appendix A.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Taxonomy section exists with >=12 failure-mode rows: `grep -q '^## Failure-mode taxonomy' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && test "$(grep -c '^| F' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -ge 12`
- [ ] Gap matrix appendix exists: `grep -q '^## Appendix A — WA gap matrix' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`
- [ ] Matrix uses the three-status vocabulary: `grep -q 'assumed-in-memo' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q 'unknown' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q 'evidenced' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`

## Testing
Deterministic grep/test commands above from repo root on branch feat/wa-discovery-questions. Docs-only; citation integrity spot-checked against docs/references manifests at PR review.
data.title: Distilling the failure-mode taxonomy and WA gap matrix
